items.name: Moving Wash Light
items.description: Moving wash lights bring full-colour washes, smooth pan and tilt, and adjustable beam spread to your production. They light stages, performers and audiences, add movement and atmosphere, and can be fully programmed from any DMX lighting console. They suit concerts, theatre, corporate events and parties.

items.name: Moving Spot Light
items.description: Moving spotlights give your production sharp, punchy beams with smooth pan and tilt, gobos, colour and focus control. Use them to pick out performers, project patterns and textures, or sweep beams through haze for big aerial looks. They can be fully programmed from any DMX lighting console and suit concerts, theatre, corporate events and parties.
